theme.description: Premium, curiosity-driven editorial style. Light mode is warm and tactile. Dark mode is deep, cinematic, and deliberate.

scale.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl lg:text-[5.5rem] tracking-tighter leading-[0.9]

typography.pairing_rules: Use Playfair Display or Instrument Serif for editorial impact (hero, quotes). Use Manrope for high-legibility body text and data points. Never use Inter or Roboto.

colors.rules: Avoid generic gradients. Color exists to direct emotion and action. Use Tinted Grays instead of pure #000000 or #FFFFFF. Restrained indigo/violet for brand essence, restrained live-red for 'Live Now' signaling.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid, low opacity. Avoid chunky borders. Prefer subtle inner strokes on glass surfaces.
visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate subtle SVG noise/grain overlays over hero sections and dark mode surfaces to remove the 'digital flatness'.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl or 2xl. MUST include 1px delicate inner stroke (border-white/20 in light, border-white/10 in dark). Never use completely transparent backgrounds without blur.

layouts.hero: Asymmetrical kinetic hero. Large serif typography with line-by-line masked reveals using framer-motion. Avoid standard two-column split.
layouts.bento_grid: Grid structure (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12) with wide gaps (gap-8). Never fill 100% perfectly; leave empty cells for tension.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-12 to p-24 for padding inside major sections. h-screen or min-h-[80vh] for hero blocks.
layouts.containers: Sections should mix full-bleed and constrained (max-w-7xl) wrappers. Use optical alignment.

motion.scroll: MANDATORY: Use `lenis` for smooth, premium scrolling physics.
motion.choreography: Use `framer-motion`. Staggered entrance for lists, slight parallax on hero images (y: [-20, 20]), and slow editorial marquee (react-fast-marquee).
motion.interactions: Hover states must lift (-translate-y-1) and increase shadow depth. Focus states must have high contrast rings.
motion.rules: Do NOT use 'transition-all'. Target specific properties (e.g., transition-transform, transition-opacity) to avoid breaking transforms.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure min 4.5:1 for body text. Use Text Shadow when placing text over cinematic images.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for all framer-motion elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards) MUST include a descriptive `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="hero-cta-button"`).

media.rules: Never use placeholder images. Images must be clipped deliberately (e.g., spotlight masks, raw borders) rather than generic rounded corners everywhere.

components.strategy: Use Shadcn logic for interactive parts, but STRIP the Vercel-look. Custom HTML/Tailwind for structural storytelling blocks.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp editorial buttons. Never standard 4px rounded rectangles. Add micro-interactions on hover.
components.cards: Avoid generic 'card grid'. Use bento grids with varying spans, background colors, and typography hierarchies. No equal-height standard grids.
components.navigation: Mobile bottom nav (Home/Live/Explore/Learning) for app feel. Desktop: Glassmorphic sticky header with logo and editorial links.

sections_breakdown.Hero: Kinetic typography. Line-by-line reveal: 'You've seen the world. / You haven't seen how it works.' Rotating curiosity search input.
sections_breakdown.Trust_Strip: Slow editorial marquee. Serif font. Pale background, dark earthy text.
sections_breakdown.Featured_Story: Aviation editorial. Full-bleed or dramatically clipped image (aviation_hero), large serif quotes.
sections_breakdown.Explore_by_Field: Asymmetrical layout routing to /topic/*. Mix hardware (microchip), business (founder).
sections_breakdown.Expert_Showcase: Demo profiles featuring expert_speaker and startup_founder.
sections_breakdown.Live_Now: Cards with restrained live-red pulse indicators.
sections_breakdown.Why_Live: Interaction story with scrolling text and sticky image.
sections_breakdown.Live_Room_Preview: Immersive dark section using live_audience image.
sections_breakdown.How_It_Works: Numbered manifesto chapters. Oversized typography numbers (01, 02).
sections_breakdown.Knowledge_Journey: Data visualization styled beautifully (learner stats, Yashraj).
sections_breakdown.Footer: Massive typography. Light mode body means Dark mode footer.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are creating an award-worthy Awwwards Site-of-the-Day experience. Reject standard SaaS templates.
Implement light and dark themes comprehensively using standard Tailwind dark mode.
Use framer-motion for kinetic typography and scroll reveals.
Ensure all text contrasting over images has adequate shadows or gradient overlays.
Do NOT use HTML <select>. Use customized Shadcn components for forms/inputs.
Adhere strictly to the spacing scale. Err on the side of too much negative space.
Ensure every interactive element has a `data-testid` for robust testing.
Build the mobile bottom nav specifically for small screens.
DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for the sticky header; use backdrop-blur and a semi-transparent color.
